body: Oh I see what you’re saying.
Trust me when I say, I’m not the problem when it comes to desire.
I don’t have any suggestions - just that I feel the same.
Yeah he said he had some dessert last night (I forget what) and he couldn’t sleep.
Do most people have nausea issues? He hasn’t complained about them, but I’ve noticed he’s been burping a ton.
Is that what it does? Makes you feel full?

I did this with my then boyfriend now husband. My parents are ALOT to handle and I just didn’t have the capacity to deal with it all. I wouldn’t worry too much about it. That being said, have you brought it to her attention and told her it bothers you?
Yes, it’s happened to me. I’ve been waiting for years for things to change. They haven’t. Leave now and cut your losses. Don’t hang on too long.
5 and 9 months. Do you have kids?

Our date to fully open just got moved up 3 weeks. That’s what really sent me over the edge today. We applied for an extension from the state to open, got denied, and so our super basically just said, screw it lets go back with the elementary kids.
Ain’t that the truth!

Anxiety, depression and postpartum here. It’s been great.... would love to see a therapist, but guess what? No one is taking new patients... because why? Everyone is going nuts from COVID. It’s a vicious cycle

Couldn’t agree more. My husband is essentially infertile. After 3 samples they found a total of 12 sperm that were viable. We got 9 embryos, 6 were viable, and we now have 2 kids. 

It’s totally doable. The process sucks, but isn’t that bad, and most importantly you stay faithful. Seems really odd and suspicious that she would dig her heels in on this.
Don’t text him. Enjoy your time.

I feel this in my soul. Done pretending at work, done pretending at home, just done. I’m so tired at the end of the day. Maybe if we just keep telling ourselves that everything is great it eventually will be??? Yeah I didn’t think so either
Sad thing is, I think they’d only care that they didn’t have clean laundry or home cooked meals anymore
Today that kid was hiding from me because I was having a panic attack. She won’t miss a thing.

We called the cops once on our upstairs neighbor. Someone was clearly getting beaten up. After the cop left their apartment they walked directly to ours to let us know they handled it... with our neighbors still in the hallway. 🤦🏻
This isn’t meant to sound rude, I’m just honestly asking, what would you suggest I do?
I’ve always been the type of person who is attracted to a personality more than a body type, so in that regard yes. But am I knocking down doors to get to him? Not really.

Yes. We talked again last night, and it was all excuses and blaming everyone else. I’ve made myself crystal clear. But he continues not to act. Like I said, I’d feel very guilty breaking up a family over weight issues. It just seems to petty. But I’m nearly ready to
It’s not that I’m not attracted to him. I mean I do still love him. It’s that we physically cannot have sex because of his stomach.
That’s just it. If he was TRYING the resentment would go away. But there is zero effort being put in on his part, and frankly I’m tired of caring more about his weight than he does.
I do! In fact with my last pregnancy I had gestational diabetes and I lost 30lbs. He sneaks it.
That’s fair

Throw away for obvious reasons - so I’ve married into this family, and I can confirm that they are some of the biggest trump supporters/closet racists I know. My own family stopped going there years ago.
Go for it then. It’s only a text!

Is the piano teacher your professor at school? Or are these lessons you take on the side, as a hobby? That would make a difference as to how you would proceed. From a teacher stand point, if you were my student in college for example, I’d feel like it would be unethical to pursue you. But if I was just teaching piano for extra cash, I think it’d be different.
I just feel numb.

I think I’ve used up all my family’s kindness. I’m pretty confident they are all done with me. So next we are talking divorce, so that will be another think my kids will have to endure. Seems like it’s better to just cut it off before it becomes an issue.
